name: Cybership
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, put the top two cards of that player's library onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.
Crew 4
blocked_sentences: Whenever this Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, put the top two cards of that player's library onto the battlefield face down under your control. They're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures.

needs.what: put the top N cards of a player's library onto the battlefield face down under your control as face-down permanents with printed-by-effect characteristics (2/2 Artifact Creature — Cyberman), and with no turn-face-up permission (they are not manifested, so 701.34c does not apply)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `manifest` (with controller: you, player bound to the damaged player, amount 2) makes the plain colorless typeless 2/2 shell and marks the cards manifested, so it lacks the Artifact type and Cyberman subtype and wrongly lets creature cards be turned face up for their mana cost; it has no option to set the face-down shell's types/subtypes or forbid turning up
